answer.reason: Only the Exodus verse tells of something that happened in the wilderness of Shur; the other verses use Shur as a boundary marker.

clauses.english: was where Israel went three days after the Red Sea and found no water
clauses.quote: they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water

doubts: GEN 16:7 places Hagar's meeting with the angel at a fountain on the way to Shur, not in Shur itself, so it was left out.
GEN 20:1, GEN 25:18, 1SA 15:7 and 1SA 27:8 only use Shur as a boundary or landmark.
